description: When Ghibli Museum, SHIBUYA SKY and teamLab tickets go on sale, and which dates and slots are still open.

tools.name: source_ghibli-calendar
tools.description: Ghibli Museum official ticket page with the museum calendar.

novel_features.name: Act-now trip state
novel_features.description: For each sight and visit date in a trip, see whether to book now, wait for an exact JST sale moment, or drop the date. Ghibli Museum and SHIBUYA SKY show 'unknown' once their sale opens (stock needs a login or sits behind a waiting room).

novel_features.name: SHIBUYA SKY sunset targeting
novel_features.description: See the computed sunset time, the 20-minute SHIBUYA SKY slots to target (on an assumed :00/:20/:40 grid), their web price tier and the moment that date goes on sale. Slot stock is not read.

novel_features.name: Party-size fit
novel_features.description: For teamLab venues, keep only time slots with enough stock for the whole party; for every sight, flag channel rules for children (for example SHIBUYA SKY child tickets at the counter only).
